proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat.openFallback — inline non-feat bundle alternative
proposed_widenings.justification: The Paladin Fighting Style feature offers two paths: (a) pick a Fighting Style feat, or (b) choose Blessed Warrior — an in-class option that is NOT a feat but grants a specific effect bundle (two Cleric cantrips with Charisma as spellcasting ability). The current `openFallback` field only supports `"any_qualifying_feat"`, not a named custom non-feat alternative. A new variant is needed to express 'instead of this feat grant, choose this specific inline option.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see 'Feats' for feats). Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below. Blessed Warrior. You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice..."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access — spellcastingAbility override field
proposed_widenings.justification: Blessed Warrior explicitly specifies 'Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them.' The `grant_spell_access` atom has no field to override the spellcasting ability used for the granted spells. This is needed to distinguish spells granted with a non-default casting ability (here the feature explicitly anchors to Charisma rather than leaving it implicit).
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The chosen cantrips count as Paladin spells for you, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access — per-level swap mechanic
proposed_widenings.justification: Blessed Warrior includes 'Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip.' This is a build-time swap-on-level-up cadence. The surface has no field on `grant_spell_access` (or elsewhere) to express this recurring replacement eligibility.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip."

notes: The `grant_feat { category: 'fighting_style' }` part encodes cleanly — same pattern as fighter_fighting_style_l1. The Blessed Warrior alternative is omitted from the authored JSON because the surface has no mechanism for 'feat OR custom non-feat bundle' choices. The three widening proposals all concern the Blessed Warrior path; none require new v4 taxonomy atoms (grant_feat and grant_spell_access already exist). The fighter version's per-level replacement mechanic ('Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat...') is similarly not encoded there, so that gap is pre-existing and not classified here.
